title: Debias-SparseGPT: Bias-Aware Pruning for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper assesses demographic representational bias in large language models across several categories, explicitly including 'Religion' in its benchmarks (UnQover, BBQ). It presents category-wise accuracy on UnQover (including Religion) and performs a specific ablation study using a religion-specific subset of calibration data to observe its effect on bias mitigation.
